note: Shape A (11-phase). Architecture outputs (architecture.md, architecture.meta.json, ux-design-spec) are Phase 6 and Phase 5 outputs — not Phase 4 exit conditions.

acceptance_checks.remediation: Phase 1 Bootstrap must be complete before Phase 4. Run `coldpress init` if not done.
Phase 3 Tech Stack must be complete. Run `@architect stack-locking` to lock the tech stack.

acceptance_checks.description: Sacred PRD `_context/sacred/prd.md` exists with `sacred: true` frontmatter
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm create-prd` to author the Product Requirements Document.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/sacred/prd.meta.json` exists and validates against `schemas/handoffs/prd-to-architecture.schema.ts` — Phase 4→Phase 6 handoff contract
acceptance_checks.remediation: Re-run `create-prd` step-05-finalize — the sidecar is emitted at PRD finalization. Verify `create-prd` SKILL.md outputs include prd.meta.json.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/prd-validation-{date}.md` exists confirming PRD completeness check was run
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@pm validate-prd` to catch internal inconsistencies before Phase 5.
Run `@pm planning-entry-sync` — the scope memo is required for Phase 4 skills to load the correct context.
Run `@pm legacy-assessment` if `_input/legacy/` contains files to assess for migration.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/handoffs/phase-4-to-5-{date}.md` exists (emitted by phase-transition invocation at Phase 4 exit)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Invoke `phase-transition` at Phase 4 exit to trigger graph rebuild + handoff log write.
